summary: Elevate Accounting is a South Perth boutique firm founded by Shane Crommelin in 2016, with about 19 staff, a cloud-technology focus, bookkeeping and payroll plus CFO-style advisory, and multiple national awards. It promoted a sixth director in July 2026 and has advertised for a Supervisor/Manager to grow the team.

sources.title: Celebrating the Promotion of Ashlee Carter to Director

claims.text: Elevate Accounting is based at Level 9, 1 Richardson Street, South Perth WA.
Shane Crommelin is Director & Founder of Elevate Accounting (since July 2016), based in South Perth.
claims.quote: Director & Founder - Elevate Accounting (Current) Jul 2016 - Present

claims.text: Shane is a Certified Xero Advisor and left a Partner role at a large national firm to found Elevate.
Elevate says it embraces cloud technology for automation and insights.
claims.quote: embrace Cloud technology for automation and insights

claims.text: Elevate says its team of 19 staff cover bookkeeping, payroll, accounting, tax, strategy, financing and business sale.
claims.quote: Our experienced team of 19 staff have over 200 years of combined experience.

claims.text: In July 2026 Elevate promoted Ashlee Carter to Director and Shareholder, joining a director group that includes Shane.
claims.quote: We are delighted to announce the promotion of Ashlee Carter to Director and Shareholder at Elevate Accounting.

claims.text: Shane posted that Elevate is growing and looking for an experienced Supervisor/Manager to help grow the team.
claims.quote: Elevate Accounting are growing, and we are looking for an experienced Supervisor/Manager to help grow the team.

claims.text: Elevate won Australian Accounting Awards New Partner of the Year in 2024 and multiple Business Advisory Firm of the Year titles.
claims.quote: WINNER 2024 New Partner of the Year

claims.text: Elevate offers bookkeeping and payroll, cash flow management and tax strategy to WA businesses.

hooks.text: Elevate already positions on cloud automation; Vert adds reconciliation speed with a traceable trail.
Supervisor/Manager hiring post suggests capacity pressure in the review layer.
New sixth director shows growth; Shane's Certified Xero Advisor status makes Xero-native workflow credible.

risks.text: Shane also leads Modus Capital, so attention may be split.
Hiring post is from June 2025 and may be stale.

gaps: No podcast or recent Shane-authored content found.
No confirmed tool stack beyond Xero and general cloud claims.
